description: This Java class 'CompatibilityChecker' assesses whether an Android APK is compatible with the user's device by checking SDK versions, device features, and native code support.

classes.name: CompatibilityChecker
classes.description: A utility class to determine APK compatibility with the device.

methods.name: CompatibilityChecker
methods.description: Constructor initializing context, features, CPU architectures, and forceTouchApps flag.

methods.name: compatibleApi
methods.description: Checks if the APK's native code supports the device's CPU architectures.

methods.name: getIncompatibleReasons
methods.description: Returns a list of reasons why the APK may be incompatible with the device.
